svg.title: FINTRAC RAG bot architecture
svg.desc: A two-phase architecture showing document ingestion at the top and the query flow at the bottom, with FINTRAC PDFs being chunked, embedded, and stored in ChromaDB, then queried via Llama running locally to produce cited answers delivered to Slack.
svg.text: Slack question → retrieve → Llama → cited answer

g.text: No data leaves the machine at any step
Boundary: everything inside this box runs on your laptop — zero cloud calls, zero API keys
